title: SilkTouchAmethyst
description: Simple plugin that allows you to collect Budding Amethyst with Silk Touch.
body: # SilkTouchAmethyst SilkTouchAmethyst is a simple plugin that allows players to collect Budding Amethyst blocks by mining them with Silk Touch. No configuration, no commands, just plug and play! ## Requirements * Java 17 or newer * Server Software with Bukkit API. ## Support For bug reports and feature requests I'd prefer you use the [GitHub Issue Tracker](https://github.com/firewolf8385/SilkTouchAmethyst/issues). ## bStats
